Investors are keenly awaiting third-quarter results in October to gauge future performance.

summary: Biogen is diversifying its pipeline beyond neurology into immunology and nephrology, with 10 Phase III programs nearing clinical readouts. The company expects significant cost savings from its "Fit for Growth" initiative and the Apellis acquisition, while planning to explore earlier-stage deals in various therapeutic areas. title: Tesla signals Oct 1 launch for long-delayed Roadster
summary: Tesla has indicated an October 1 launch for its long-delayed Roadster, nearly a decade after the next-generation version was first revealed. The company posted a "Go for launch" message on social media platform X with the date "10.01," and reports suggest the event could include a demonstration of a limited-edition version with cold-gas thrusters developed with SpaceX. The Roadster, initially unveiled in 2017 with deliveries promised by 2020, has faced repeated delays.

title: Corbus Pharmaceuticals to Host Conference Call to Discuss Topline Data from CANYON-1 Clinical Trial and the Potential of CRB-913 In Obesity
summary: Corbus Pharmaceuticals will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, September 14, 2026, to discuss topline data from its CANYON-1 Phase 1b clinical trial of CRB-913 for obesity. CRB-913 is a peripherally restricted CB1 inverse agonist, offering a potentially new approach to weight management. Dr. Harold Bays, an investigator for the study, will be a guest speaker, providing expert insight into the clinical trial findings and the potential of CRB-913.

title: Kimberly-Clark's 54-Year Dividend Streak Faces Its Biggest Test Yet With $48.7 Billion Kenvue Deal
summary: Kimberly-Clark (KMB) recently extended its 54-year dividend increase streak while simultaneously pursuing a $48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue (KVUE), raising concerns among income investors. The company's operating cash flow barely covers its current dividend and capital expenditure, and the Kenvue deal is expected to put significant pressure on its balance sheet. While management expresses confidence in synergies from the acquisition, the market is pricing in real risk, as KMB shares have fallen 20% over the past year, pushing its dividend yield to 5%.

title: Anchorage Digital Bank, BitGo join Coinbase to custody 21Shares crypto ETFs
summary: Asset manager 21Shares has added Anchorage Digital Bank and BitGo as new custodians for its spot cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (ETFs), joining existing custodian Coinbase. This move aims to diversify custody partners, minimizing single points of failure for its ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF and 21Shares Core Ethereum ETF. The decision aligns with increasing scrutiny from the SEC on client asset custody and reflects a trend among institutional crypto companies towards regulated, secure storage solutions.

The company's cautious yet effective approach to technology investment aims to enhance member experience without replicating the extensive infrastructure of competitors like Amazon and Walmart.

title: Meta accused in class action of profiting from scam cryptocurrency ads

The plaintiffs claim Meta is aware of these fraudulent ads but fails to take adequate measures to stop them, instead using AI to optimize their effectiveness. The lawsuit seeks to represent a nationwide class of users who suffered losses from crypto scams promoted through these ads, suing for violations of California consumer laws and breach of contract.

Morgan Stanley suggests the upcoming redesign of the Chewy+ membership program and growth in its healthcare business could be catalysts for a future re-rating of the stock.
